subject.title: All LLM API calls time out simultaneously despite APIs being reachable (multi-agent concurrency issue)

question: Should #43374 remain the canonical current-main four-agent Telegram/provider live-repro item, be split into narrower runtime/provider/Telegram issues, or close only after comparable main/release proof shows the timeout pattern is gone?
rationale: Current source shows meaningful partial fixes but not enough proof to know whether the remaining bottleneck belongs to Telegram ingress, provider transport, fallback budgeting, session locking, or operator configuration.

options.title: Keep canonical live-repro item
options.body: Keep #43374 open until maintainers have a current-main multi-agent Telegram/provider trace and then route a focused fix to the proven owner boundary.

options.title: Split into narrower items
options.body: Replace this broad report with separate Telegram ingress, provider transport, fallback-budget, and session-lock issues if maintainers want independently owned follow-up work.

options.title: Close after release proof
options.body: Close only if maintainers can cite a release or current-main live proof that reproduces the original setup and shows the simultaneous timeout pattern is gone.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical live-repro item
recommendation.body: Keep #43374 open until maintainers have a current-main multi-agent Telegram/provider trace and then route a focused fix to the proven owner boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and discussed the most directly related merged fallback-cascade mitigation.
